acceptance.note: Phase 3 gate G3 per master-plan v2.1 §9: tip deflection within 5% of transformed-section value; merge-vs-tie relative difference <= 1e-6. p=1 coarse levels are record-only diagnostics (locking in bending) but finest h3 carries the same 5% criterion.

boundary_conditions.clamp: z=0 end face pinned (all translations fixed)
boundary_conditions.interface: Two workflows: (a) boolean merge — layers one part sharing interface nodes; (b) separate parts joined by tie constraint. Traction case also run with tie workflow.

body_force.target: layer-specific, -y direction; pointwise identical to gravity case

end_moment.note: About x-axis at beam tip; applied to reference point at end-face centroid via kinematic coupling to whole face. Phase 3 (G3) case.

gravity.target: whole body, -y direction; equivalent line load w = g*b*(rho_f*hf + rho_s*hs)

materials.note_nu_zero: Poisson's ratio intentionally zero in both layers so the 3D solid stays compatible with the Euler-Bernoulli accepted solution.

mesh_sweep.discretization: immersed trimmed U-splines, rectilinear background grid, p padding elements per side
